description: Broad intent-router top-k dataset. expected_primary should appear within top 3; support routes are useful follow-on routes but are not required for hit@3.

cases.query: Use intent-router. The current automation system is terrible; search again, build on another project, and redesign it into a personalized, verifiable, iterative system with scheduled actions.
cases.rationale: A broad, emotionally negative, multi-system redesign needs design discovery before research, implementation, or scheduling.

cases.query: I have a rough product idea. Brainstorm with me first and clarify the core requirement and direction before implementation.
cases.rationale: Explicit brainstorming and direction-setting should lead with upstream discovery.

cases.query: This existing repo needs a feature, but I cannot describe it clearly yet. Help me shape this change.
cases.rationale: Existing repo plus fuzzy but bounded change calls for a funnel question, not full intake.

cases.query: I want to build a new app from scratch and only have a rough direction.
cases.rationale: Starting a new product from scratch should route to intake before implementation.

cases.query: This page looks cheap. Make it feel polished and ready to ship.
cases.rationale: Visual quality and shipping feel are design-led.

cases.query: The component state toggle and responsive layout are broken on mobile.
cases.rationale: State/responsive behavior is UI engineering first.

cases.query: Open localhost and click the login button, then screenshot the result.
cases.rationale: Open/click/screenshot is a browser tool route.

cases.query: Production returns 500 sometimes. Do not guess. Find the root cause.
cases.rationale: Hard intermittent production bug needs reproduction or logs before fixing.

cases.query: Tests fail with this error. Help me fix the command failure.
cases.rationale: Straight command/test failure should inspect the exact error and smallest repro.

cases.query: The behavior is clear. Implement this feature in thin slices and add tests.
cases.rationale: Clear implementation should proceed in slices with tests.

cases.query: Review this diff for bugs, regressions, and missing tests. Findings first.
cases.rationale: Review stance should inspect the diff and lead with findings.

cases.query: What is the latest API behavior? Use official docs, not memory.
cases.rationale: Current API facts require official/current sources.

cases.query: Which plugin should I use to search my cloud documents? Recommend only.
cases.rationale: Recommendation intent is not install or execution intent.

cases.query: Use the Slack connector to find the latest team decision.
cases.rationale: A connector route must check callability before claiming it used the connector.

cases.query: Run the OpenAI API to generate embeddings for this folder.
cases.rationale: Paid API usage needs current docs and a quota/cost approval gate.

cases.query: Deploy this app to production and give me the public URL.
cases.rationale: Deployment mutates external state and needs target/environment confirmation.

cases.query: Turn this report into an editable Word docx.
cases.rationale: Editable Word output should not route to a PDF-only workflow.

cases.query: Make an editable PowerPoint PPTX deck, not just a PDF.
cases.rationale: Editable deck output should route to presentation/PPTX tooling.

cases.query: Make a polished one-page PDF portfolio.
cases.rationale: Polished PDF/one-pager output is the PDF deliverable route.

cases.query: Search my local wiki and explain what the notes say about agent memory.
cases.rationale: Local knowledge-base source should not be replaced by generic web search.

cases.query: Remind me every weekday at 9am to review the trading plan.
cases.rationale: Recurring future follow-up needs exact scheduling and timezone handling.

cases.query: Commit these changes, push them, and open a PR.
cases.rationale: Publishing changes requires dirty-state and remote/branch preflight.

cases.query: Update this skill and add eval cases for the new routing behavior.
cases.rationale: Skill updates should include route-map sync and eval coverage.

cases.query: Analyze this CSV and create an xlsx tracker with formulas and charts.
cases.rationale: Tabular analysis and workbook output should route to spreadsheet tooling.
